steps.thought: I need to list the available tests to understand the test suite and their costs before diagnosing the unit.

tests.name: power_on_selftest
tests.description: Boot the unit and enumerate devices on I2C, UART and CAN.

tests.name: battery_rest_check
tests.description: Read pack and per-cell voltages at rest.

tests.name: esc_telemetry
tests.description: Read ESC telemetry: sync errors, packet loss, back-EMF detection.

tests.name: compass_static
tests.description: Compare compass heading to the fixture reference with motors off.

tests.name: harness_continuity
tests.description: Measure per-bus continuity resistance and CAN termination.

tests.name: camera_selftest
tests.description: Run camera built-in self test and measure frame rate and CSI errors.

tests.name: imu_static
tests.description: Log 1000 IMU samples on the static fixture: gyro bias, accel noise, dropouts.

tests.name: motor_spin_test
tests.description: Spin all motors at 50 percent throttle: current, RPM, RPM jitter, temp.

tests.name: compass_motor_interference
tests.description: Sweep throttle 0-75 percent and log compass heading deviation.

tests.name: battery_load_test
tests.description: Apply a 20 A load and measure sag, cell imbalance, internal resistance.

steps.thought: I will run power_on_selftest first to quickly enumerate all devices and check for any basic communication or subsystem faults.
steps.observation: The power on selftest passed successfully, enumerating all expected devices on I2C, UART, and CAN without any reported failures. This rules out major bus faults and dead controllers, leaving component-specific performance, calibration, and intermittent issues as remaining hypotheses.

hypotheses.rationale: Initial power on selftest passed with all devices found and no error flags.
Power on selftest does not evaluate calibration accuracy; IMU must be checked further.
Motor and propeller balance require active spin testing to detect.
Static selftest passes, but magnetic interference may appear under load.
Resting voltage check required to rule out hidden battery cell degradation.

steps.thought: I will run the battery_rest_check to verify cell balance and resting voltage, which is a cheap and quick way to rule out battery degradation.
steps.observation: The battery rest check passed successfully with a nominal pack voltage of 16.61V, well-balanced cells (0.014V imbalance), and no failures reported.

hypotheses.rationale: Both power_on_selftest and battery_rest_check passed with no anomalies.
Basic power-on passed, but IMU calibration needs a static sensor test to verify.
Propeller or motor vibration issues require spin testing to evaluate.
Compass must be evaluated under motor load or static test to ensure no magnetic issues.

steps.thought: I will run the esc_telemetry test to check for any commutation sync errors or packet loss before doing more expensive motor or sensor tests.
steps.observation: ESC telemetry test passed successfully across all four ESCs with no sync errors, low packet loss, normal temperatures, and back-EMF detected on all channels. This rules out major ESC and motor commutation issues.

hypotheses.rationale: Power-on, battery rest, and ESC telemetry tests have all passed cleanly with no failures.
IMU subsystem has not yet been tested with imu_static to check for gyro bias or noise.
Motor spin test is required to evaluate mechanical balance and vibration.
Compass static and motor interference tests are needed to verify magnetic heading.

steps.thought: I will run the imu_static test to check for gyro miscalibration, sensor faults, or mounting issues, covering the IMU subsystem next.
steps.observation: The imu_static test failed due to an excessive gyro z-axis bias of 1.379 dps, which exceeds the limit of 0.3 dps. This points directly to a gyro miscalibration or sensor fault.

hypotheses.rationale: Gyro z bias of 1.379 dps significantly exceeds the maximum allowed limit of 0.3 dps during the imu_static test.
Persistent high gyro bias can occasionally stem from a failing IMU sensor component rather than a simple calibration offset.

steps.thought: The gyro z-axis bias clearly exceeds the specification limit in the imu_static test, pointing directly to a gyro miscalibration that can be resolved by recalibration.
